    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The head is one button with aria-expanded; its name carries the status and who is ahead
      - listitem: The metric switch and the variants are radio groups; every variant's name includes its value and its change against the baseline
      - listitem: The small chart in the head is decorative – everything it shows is in the rows
      - listitem: While the card is closed, everything inside is inert; the line in the last row is announced politely
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Nothing travels: the head stays where it is and the comparison unfolds below it while it fades in"
      - listitem: Switching the metric rolls every number in one shared tween while bars and columns glide to their new size; the soft fill of the switch moves along in a short, crisp step
      - listitem: Hovering a variant widens its column in the head and fades the others – and the other way round
      - listitem: Picking a winner turns its badge into a check and pops the dark action button into the last row
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches without movement
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container up to 340px; below 300px the note next to the status goes and the chips tighten
      - listitem: "Touch screens: a tap opens, a tap outside closes, rows and the metric switch are taller"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: "Changes are measured against the control (the variant with control: true, else the first). With lowerIsBetter a drop is shown as it is (−7.5%) but colored green and counted as the lead"
      - listitem: Pass raw numbers and do the formatting in the metric's format, so the rolling values stay smooth
      - listitem: The card does not compute confidence – pass what your stats engine gives you
